scope: Controlled private heap, not terminal memory attribution

final.limits: Outermost observed heap API calls only; excludes nested allocator requests, pre-attach and out-of-scope allocations. This must be the only interceptor on the owned process. Requested bytes are not private working set. Instrumentation may change allocation behaviour.
